name: Best-lit spot near the pole
note: Brightest point within 20 km of the pole in NASA's LOLA illumination map (88.4% of the time over 18.6 years). Derived by us, not a named site.
source: NASA PGDA Lunar Polar Illumination, AVGVISIB_85S_060M_201608
provenance: Terrain: NASA LOLA LDEM_60S_240M (240 m/px). Ephemeris: JPL DE421 via Skyfield, MOON_ME frame. Curvature included, no refraction. Validated against JPL Horizons and NASA LOLA illumination maps.
